mechanism: Follow one subject through a real public route without stopping the world for coverage. Start in side profile, let the camera drift behind as the space opens, allow one incidental person or event to cross the route, capture a single restrained acknowledgment, then continue past the camera so the encounter remains a lived moment rather than a staged climax.

invariants.rule: Begin with a side-profile follow before revealing the larger route.
invariants.purpose: Creates a spatial discovery rather than an establishing postcard.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting wide removes the observer's gradual reveal.

invariants.rule: Keep the subject walking through the camera transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping for coverage makes the passage feel staged.

invariants.rule: Allow exactly one incidental crossing or encounter to enter the established route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple incidents turn observation into montage.

invariants.rule: Use one restrained acknowledgment without halting the route.
invariants.purpose: Gives the event emotional weight while staying naturalistic.
invariants.ablation_failure: A large reaction becomes a climax the scene has not earned.

invariants.rule: End with continued movement past or away from camera.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the encounter embedded in ordinary life.
invariants.ablation_failure: A posed final look converts the piece into a portrait.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source flower shop and public square
